Overview of the Bank of Baroda Apprenticeship 2025

Bank of Baroda has released an official notification inviting applications for a total of 2700 apprenticeship positions. The recruitment process is currently underway, allowing eligible and interested candidates to apply through online channels. Applicants are advised to review all official instructions and eligibility guidelines before beginning their application.

Eligibility Criteria and Requirements

To participate in the Bank of Baroda Apprenticeship Recruitment 2025, candidates must meet specific criteria outlined in the official notification:

  • Age Limit: Applicants must fall within the age bracket of 20 to 28 years.
  • Educational Qualification: Candidates are required to hold a graduation degree in any stream from a recognized institution.
  • Required Documents: Essential documents including academic mark sheets, certificates, and identity proof such as an Aadhaar card must be kept ready in order to complete the online submission successfully.

Application Procedure and Fees

Applications are being accepted exclusively through the online medium on the official platform. Candidates must review the official notification thoroughly during the process.

The application fee structure is as follows:

  • General and other applicable categories: ₹800
  • PwD candidates: ₹400
  • SC/ST candidates: Exempt from application fees

Applicants must ensure they provide a valid email address and contact number for future communication from the department. Submissions must be completed within the designated timeline.

Practical Implications and Verification

What is Confirmed

  • Bank of Baroda has announced 2700 apprenticeship openings for 2025.
  • The application process is online and currently active.
  • Age limits are set between 20 and 28 years, and a bachelor's degree in any stream is mandatory.
  • Application fees vary by category, ranging from zero for SC/ST candidates to ₹800 for general applicants.

What Remains Unknown

  • Specific selection exam dates, detailed district-wise vacancy breakdowns, and exact closing deadlines are not fully detailed in the current available text and require checking the primary portal.

How to Check the Original Announcement

Readers and prospective applicants should verify all rules, notifications, and updates directly by visiting the official source website at [Bank of Baroda Apprenticeship Recruitment 2025 Source](https://sarkarikyp.com/bankofbarodaapprenticerecruitment2025/).
